title: 충청북도 진천군과 음성군의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 충청북도 진천군과 음성군의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 1 (Areas Incorporated into the Jurisdiction of Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do)
(1) The following parcels of land in Duseong-ri, Maengdong-myeon, Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do: Lot 294-2, Lot 296-1, Lot 297-1, Lot 298-3, Lot 298-6, Lot 298-7, Lot 298-9, Lot 298-10, Lot 300-4, Lot 805-5, Lot 805-6, Lot 806-4, Lot 806-7, Lots 806-15 through 806-18, Lot 807-1, Lot 807-2, Lot 808-6, Lot 809-5, Lot 810, Lots 810-1 through 810-5, Lot 811, Lot 811-1, Lot 812, Lots 813-5 through 813-8, Lot 815-11, Lot 815-13, Lot 822-7, Lot 822-8, Lot 851, Lot 852, Lot 890-4, Lot 913-15, Lot 913-16, Mountain Lot 82-2, Mountain Lots 83-6 through 83-9, Mountain Lot 85, Mountain Lot 86-1, Mountain Lot 91-3, and Mountain Lots 110-15 through 110-17.
(2) The following parcels of land in Sindon-ri, Maengdong-myeon, Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do: Mountain Lots 39-22 through 39-24, Mountain Lot 39-34, Mountain Lot 39-35, Mountain Lot 39-44, Mountain Lot 39-48, Mountain Lot 39-49, Mountain Lot 39-54, Mountain Lot 39-58, Mountain Lots 39-85 through 39-87, Mountain Lot 42-25, and Mountain Lot 42-27.
